customManagers.description: Keep the node base image literal in uninstall.sh and the README in sync with Dockerfile.base
Keep the digest-pinned DIND sidecar image literal in the launcher current
Keep the digest-pinned cosign image that install.sh verifies the base signature with current
Keep the digest-pinned ShellCheck image that tests/check.sh runs current

packageRules.description: Bump the node base image everywhere in one PR

Pin the node base image of Dockerfile.base by digest: a tag like 24-slim is republished under the same name, so without the digest Renovate would never see those rebuilds. Only the Dockerfile; the tag literals in uninstall.sh and the README stay plain tags
Pin yq's image digest (Dockerfile.base COPYs the binary out of it); Renovate updates tag and digest together
Pin the digests of the docker CLI and DIND sidecar images
Pin the digest of the cosign image that verifies the base signature
Pin the digest of the ShellCheck image; Renovate updates tag and digest together

Merge updates of the tooling images (docker CLI, DIND sidecar, node base image, yq), majors included, once the required stub-tests and integration-tests checks pass, and not before a release is 3 days old (Docker Hub provides release timestamps); the integration tests are what vouches for them
ghcr.io gives Renovate no release timestamps, so with timestamp-required a cosign update would be held back forever; take it without the 3-day wait

A new major of cosign can change the flags or the verification itself, and no check on the pull request runs a verification (the integration tests build the base there when it changed): a person reviews it
Merge GitHub Actions updates once the required stub-tests check passes (the 3-day minimumReleaseAge applies to all dependencies); main only accepts squash merges
